title: Smooth ride and staying connected
summary: The sampled feedback combines praise for smooth, controlled driving and ample power with complaints or unclear issues around staying connected and using connected features.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise a smooth, planted feel at speed and strong power delivery that remains refined.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize difficult smartphone connectivity and an awkward built-in dashcam interface.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review mentions a cable popping out instead of staying connected, but the specific system or context is unclear.

limitations: The topic mixes driving dynamics, power delivery, smartphone connectivity, dashcam usability, and a cable-connection issue rather than one clearly unified subject.
The sample is very small and stratified, so it is only enough to describe these fragments and not broader customer experience.
The undetermined example does not provide enough context to identify which cable or feature is affected.
